n: micro:bit proxy lamps (Newcastle University Open Lab)
t: Tabletop micro:bit lamps that let students practise stage lighting control.
steps: Find the project page from Newcastle University Open Lab and read about the Gig Academy project.
Ask IT and a teacher with electronics skills to review the plan.
Gather micro:bits, LEDs, laser-cut cases and a Raspberry Pi.
Build the lamps and the broker.
Set up Open Lighting Architecture on the Raspberry Pi.
Connect the lighting control software to the broker.
Test one lamp before building more.
